remarks: Fabulous 5-Bedroom Cape on a Picturesque Pond  Welcome to this charming 5-bedroom Cape nestled beside a serene pond-perfect for those who love peaceful views and outdoor entertaining. Relax or host guests on the spacious patio overlooking the water, creating the ideal setting for memorable gatherings.  Inside, the home offers incredible potential with a flexible layout. A separate entrance leads to two versatile rooms and a full bath-ideal for an in-law suite, guest space, or home office setup.  The main living room features a large bay window that fills the space with natural light. Enjoy pond views from both the kitchen and formal dining room. The inviting family room boasts cathedral ceilings and a cozy fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere.  This unique home offers both comfort and opportunity-don't miss your chance to make it yours!
